```typescript
import "./WebsiteLeadPeriods.css";
import { DropdownField } from "./ui/DropdownField";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { query, quote, health, type Row } from "../data/duckdb";
import { historicalTransient, comparisonDates } from "../data/periods";
import { metrics, metricSQL, contributorPredicate } from "../semantics/metrics";
import { metricTable } from "../semantics/catalogue";
import { fmt, delta } from "../semantics/formats";
import { useStore } from "../state/store";
import { context, where, today } from "../data/analytics";

import { WEBSITE, websiteScope, marketingMetricSQL, marketingDimension, marketingDimensionOptions, marketingContributor, websitePeriodWindows, websiteColumns } from "../data/performance-marketing";
import { useGroupFields } from "../data/group-registry";
const websiteIds = [...websiteColumns, "website_contact_rate", "website_untouched", "website_open", "website_pipeline_value"];
const periodDate = (value: string) => new Date(`${value}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString("en-IN", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" });
const label = (range: { from: string; to: string }) => `${periodDate(range.from)} – ${periodDate(range.to)}`;

import type { TreeRow } from "./NestedTable";
import { marketingDrill } from "./MarketingAnalytics";

export function WebsiteLeadPeriods({ version, onDrill, expanded = false, websiteOnly = true }: { version: string | number; onDrill?: (entry: TreeRow) => void; expanded?: boolean; websiteOnly?: boolean }) {
  const s = useStore();
  const ids = websiteOnly ? websiteIds : Object.keys(metrics).filter(id => metricTable(id) === "leads");
  const compareOff = s.compare === "none";
  const sourceEmpty = health.leads?.recordsCount === 0;
  const [chosen, setGroup] = useState("");
  const [multiLocation, setMultiLocation] = useState(false);
  const [lastWeek, setLastWeek] = useState(true);
  const [custom, setCustom] = useState(false);
  const [customFrom, setCustomFrom] = useState(s.filters.from || today());
  const [customTo, setCustomTo] = useState(s.filters.to || today());
  const customValid = !!customFrom && !!customTo && customFrom <= customTo;
  const activeGroup = multiLocation ? "location" : chosen;
  const registry = useGroupFields("leads", activeGroup ? [activeGroup] : []);
  // Date and month are the comparison windows themselves, so they are not segments here.
  const options = useMemo(() => marketingDimensionOptions("leads", registry, ["date", "month"]), [registry]);
  const dimension = activeGroup ? marketingDimension("leads", activeGroup) : undefined;
  const group = dimension ? activeGroup : "";
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const asOf = today();
  const windows = useMemo(() => [
    ...websitePeriodWindows(asOf).filter(w => lastWeek || w.key !== "last_week"),
    ...(custom && customValid ? [{ key: "custom", title: "Custom period", current: { from: customFrom, to: customTo }, prior: comparisonDates(customFrom, customTo, "elapsed") }] : []),
  ], [asOf, lastWeek, custom, customValid, customFrom, customTo]);
  const sourceFilters = websiteOnly ? { ...s.filters, source: [WEBSITE] } : s.filters;
  const scopeFor = (filters: typeof s.filters) => websiteOnly ? websiteScope(where({ ...filters, source: [] }, "leads", transient)) : where(filters, "leads", transient);
  // The source dimension is pinned to Website here, so a source chosen
  // elsewhere must not narrow it further.
  const transient = useMemo(
    () => historicalTransient(s.transient).filter((t) => !websiteOnly || t.field !== "source"),
    [s.transient, websiteOnly],
  );
  const sql = useMemo(
    () =>
      windows
        .flatMap((w) =>
          (["current", "prior"] as const).map((slot) => {
            const range = w[slot];
            const filters = {
              ...sourceFilters,
              from: range.from,
              to: range.to,
            };
            return `SELECT '${w.key}:${slot}' AS bucket,${dimension ? dimension.sql : "'All Website leads'"} AS segment,${(websiteOnly ? marketingMetricSQL : metricSQL)(ids, context(filters, transient))},COUNT(*) AS n FROM "leads"${scopeFor(filters)}${group ? " GROUP BY 2" : ""}`;
          }),
        )
        .join(" UNION ALL "),
    [windows, s.filters, transient, dimension, websiteOnly],
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    query(sql)
      .then((result) => {
        if (active) setRows(result);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (active) setError(String(e));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [sql, version]);
  const segments = [...new Set(rows.map(r=>String(r.segment)))].sort();
  const bucket = (key: string, segment: string) => rows.find(r=>r.bucket===key && r.segment===segment);
  const inspect = (key: string, slot: "current" | "prior", segment: string, id: string) => {
    const window = windows.find(w=>w.key===key)!;
    const filters = { ...sourceFilters, ...window[slot] };
    const scope = scopeFor(filters);
    const segmentPredicate = dimension ? `${dimension.sql}=${quote(segment)}` : "";
    const ctx = context(filters, transient);
    const contribution = (websiteOnly ? marketingContributor(id) : "")||contributorPredicate(id,ctx);
    const entry = marketingDrill("leads",scope,`${window.title} · ${slot} · ${segment} · ${metrics[id]?.label || id}`,[id],[segmentPredicate,contribution].filter(Boolean).join(" AND "),segmentPredicate);
    entry.queryContext = ctx;
    onDrill?.(entry);
  };
  return (
    <details id={websiteOnly ? "website-lead-periods" : "lead-periods"} className="secondary website-lead-periods" open={expanded || undefined}>
      <summary>
        <span className="period-summary-title"><span className="period-summary-icon" aria-hidden="true">▦</span><span>{websiteOnly ? "Website leads" : "Leads"} received · weekly, monthly & custom periods</span></span>
        <span className="period-summary-meta"><span>{windows.length} periods</span><span>{websiteOnly ? `Source exactly “${WEBSITE}”` : "Selected lead sources"}</span></span>
      </summary>
      <div className="secondary-content">
        <div className="pm-controls period-toolbar" aria-label="Period table options">
          <div className="period-toolbar-section">
            <span className="period-toolbar-caption">Period columns</span>
            <div className="period-toolbar-toggles">
              <label className="period-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={lastWeek} onChange={e=>setLastWeek(e.target.checked)}/><span>Last week</span></label>
              <label className="period-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={custom} onChange={e=>setCustom(e.target.checked)}/><span>Custom period</span></label>
            </div>
          </div>
          {custom && <div className="period-date-range">
            <label>Start date<input type="date" value={customFrom} onChange={e=>setCustomFrom(e.target.value)}/></label>
            <span className="period-date-arrow" aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            <label>End date<input type="date" value={customTo} onChange={e=>setCustomTo(e.target.value)}/></label>
          </div>}
          <div className="period-toolbar-section period-toolbar-view">
            <span className="period-toolbar-caption">Table view</span>
            <label className="period-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={multiLocation} onChange={e=>setMultiLocation(e.target.checked)}/><span>Multi-location</span></label>
          </div>
          <label className="period-group-field">Group by <DropdownField aria-label="Group period comparisons" disabled={multiLocation} value={group} onChange={event=>setGroup(event.target.value)}><option value="">All selected leads</option>{options.map(o=><option key={o.field} value={o.field}>{o.label}</option>)}</DropdownField></label>
        </div>
        {custom && !customValid && <p className="period-message period-message-error" role="alert">Choose a custom start and end date, with the end on or after the start.</p>}
        {multiLocation && <p className="period-message">Locations appear separately in one table. Selected studio filters still apply; select multiple studios or all studios to compare them.</p>}
        {error && <p role="alert">{error}</p>}
        {loading && <p role="status">Loading lead periods…</p>}
        {sourceEmpty && <p role="status">The latest Leads snapshot contains no rows. Period totals are unavailable until source data is loaded.</p>}
        {!sourceEmpty && <div className="table-scroll" role="region" aria-label="Lead period comparisons — scroll for more periods" tabIndex={0}>
          <table className="worklist-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th className="period-measure-heading" rowSpan={2} scope="col">Performance measure<small>Click a value to explore leads</small></th>
                {windows.map((w) => (
                  <th className="period-window-heading" key={w.key} scope="colgroup" colSpan={compareOff ? 1 : 3}>
                    <span className="period-window-title">{w.title}</span>
                    <small>
                      <span>{label(w.current)}</span>{!compareOff && <span className="period-prior-range">vs {label(w.prior)}</span>}
                    </small>
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
              <tr>
                {windows.flatMap((w) => [
                  <th className="period-current period-window-start" scope="col" key={w.key + "c"}>Current</th>,
                  ...(compareOff ? [] : [<th className="period-prior" scope="col" key={w.key + "p"}>Prior</th>, <th className="period-change" scope="col" key={w.key + "d"}>Change</th>]),
                ])}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {segments.flatMap(segment=>ids.map((id) => (
                <tr key={segment+id}>
                  <th scope="row">{group ? `${segment} · ` : ""}{metrics[id]?.label || id}</th>
                  {windows.flatMap((w) => {
                    const current = bucket(`${w.key}:current`,segment)?.[id];
                    const prior = bucket(`${w.key}:prior`,segment)?.[id];
                    return [
                      <td className="period-current period-window-start" key={w.key + "c"}><button className="pm-cell" disabled={!onDrill||current==null} onClick={()=>inspect(w.key,"current",segment,id)}>{fmt(id, current)}</button></td>,
                      ...(compareOff ? [] : [
                        <td className="period-prior" key={w.key + "p"}><button className="pm-cell" disabled={!onDrill||prior==null} onClick={()=>inspect(w.key,"prior",segment,id)}>{fmt(id, prior)}</button></td>,
                        <td className="period-change" key={w.key + "d"}><span className="period-delta">{delta(id, current, prior)}</span></td>,
                      ]),
                    ];
                  })}
                </tr>
              )))}
              {segments.map(segment=><tr className="period-contributors" key={segment}>
                <th scope="row">{group ? `${segment} · ` : ""}Contributing rows</th>
                {windows.flatMap((w) => [
                  <td className="period-current period-window-start" key={w.key + "c"}>
                    <button className="pm-cell" disabled={!onDrill} onClick={()=>inspect(w.key,"current",segment,"leads")}>{fmt("records", bucket(`${w.key}:current`,segment)?.n)}</button>
                  </td>,
                  ...(compareOff ? [] : [
                    <td className="period-prior" key={w.key + "p"}>
                      <button className="pm-cell" disabled={!onDrill} onClick={()=>inspect(w.key,"prior",segment,"leads")}>{fmt("records", bucket(`${w.key}:prior`,segment)?.n)}</button>
                    </td>,
                    <td className="period-change" key={w.key + "d"}>—</td>,
                  ]),
                ])}
              </tr>)}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>}
        <p className="period-footnote">
          Last Week covers the completed Monday–Sunday week. Custom dates use the chosen range and compare the preceding equal-length period. Week, month, quarter and year windows run to today and ignore the page
          date filter; the 30-day window is rolling. Other filters still apply.
          Outcomes are the latest recorded statuses for leads created in each window.
        </p>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}

import { GitBranch } from "lucide-react";
import { query } from "../../data/duckdb";
import { ensureSource } from "../../data/loader";
import { context, metricFacts } from "../../data/analytics";
import { metricSQL, metrics } from "../../semantics/metrics";
import { metricTable } from "../../semantics/catalogue";
import { fmt } from "../../semantics/formats";
import { useStore } from "../../state/store";
import { funnelSteps } from "../../data/overview-board";
import { useBoardData } from "./useBoardData";

// Lead stages follow one another. Converted and retained newcomers are separate outcomes of the same
// cohort (a retained client need not have converted), so they are shown against the cohort, not step to step.
const funnels = [
  { title: "Leads to members", ids: ["leads", "trials_completed", "converted_leads"], sequential: true },
  { title: "New client outcomes", ids: ["new_clients", "new_converted", "new_retained"], sequential: false },
];

/** Each funnel reads one governed source, so its steps match the figures on the other tabs. */
export function ConversionFunnel({ version }: { version: string }) {
  const filters = useStore((s) => s.filters);
  const transient = useStore((s) => s.transient);
  const { data, loading, error } = useBoardData(
    () =>
      Promise.all(
        funnels.map(async (f) => {
          const table = metricTable(f.ids[0]);
          if (!table) throw new Error(`${f.title} has no source sheet.`);
          await ensureSource(table);
          const rows = await query(`SELECT ${metricSQL(f.ids, context(filters, transient))} FROM ${metricFacts(filters, table, transient)}`);
          const steps = funnelSteps(f.ids.map((id) => ({ id, label: metrics[id].label, value: rows[0]?.[id] == null ? null : Number(rows[0][id]) })));
          return f.sequential ? steps : steps.map((s) => ({ ...s, ofPrevious: null, biggestDrop: false }));
        }),
      ),
    [filters, transient, version],
  );
  return (
    <article className="board-card board-funnel">
      <header><div className="board-heading"><span className="board-kicker"><GitBranch size={14} aria-hidden="true" />Acquisition & progression</span><h3>Conversion funnels</h3><p>Follow each stage of the journey</p></div></header>
      {error ? (
        <p className="board-state board-error" role="alert">{error}</p>
      ) : loading && !data ? (
        <p className="board-state" role="status">Counting each step…</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="board-funnels" aria-busy={loading}>
          {funnels.map((f, i) => {
            const steps = data?.[i] || [];
            return (
              <section className="board-funnel-panel" key={f.title}>
                <h4>{f.title}</h4><p className="board-funnel-caption">{f.sequential ? "Progression between recorded lead stages" : "Independent outcomes of the first-visit cohort"}</p>
                {!steps[0] || !steps[0].value ? (
                  <p className="board-state" role="status">No {metrics[f.ids[0]].label.toLowerCase()} in this period.</p>
                ) : (
                  <ol>
                    {steps.map((s) => (
                      <li key={s.id} className={s.biggestDrop ? "drop" : ""}>
                        <span className="board-funnel-bar" style={{ width: `${Math.max(4, (s.ofFirst ?? 0) * 100)}%` }} aria-hidden="true" />
                        <span className="board-funnel-label">{s.label}</span>
                        <strong className="number">{fmt(s.id, s.value)}</strong>
                        <small>
                          {f.sequential
                            ? s.ofPrevious === null ? "" : `${(s.ofPrevious * 100).toFixed(0)}% of previous`
                            : s.ofFirst === null || s === steps[0] ? "" : `${(s.ofFirst * 100).toFixed(0)}% of ${steps[0].label.toLowerCase()}`}
                          {s.biggestDrop ? " · biggest drop-off" : ""}
                        </small>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ol>
                )}
              </section>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

import { ChartPie } from "lucide-react";
import { query } from "../../data/duckdb";
import { ensureSource } from "../../data/loader";
import { context, metricFacts } from "../../data/analytics";
import { metricSQL } from "../../semantics/metrics";
import { fmt } from "../../semantics/formats";
import { useStore } from "../../state/store";
import { topNWithOther } from "../../data/overview-board";
import { useBoardData } from "./useBoardData";

const palette = ["var(--accent)", "#0ea5e9", "#f59e0b", "#e11d48", "#14b8a6", "#64748b", "#a3a3a3"];

/** Gross revenue split by sales category: the six largest and the remainder as "Other". */
export function RevenueMix({ version }: { version: string }) {
  const filters = useStore((s) => s.filters);
  const transient = useStore((s) => s.transient);
  const { data, loading, error } = useBoardData(async () => {
    await ensureSource("sales");
    const rows = await query(
      `SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(category AS VARCHAR)),''),'Uncategorised') AS label, ${metricSQL(["gross_revenue"], context(filters, transient))} FROM ${metricFacts(filters, "sales", transient)} GROUP BY 1`,
    );
    return topNWithOther(rows.map((r) => ({ label: String(r.label), value: Number(r.gross_revenue) })), 6);
  }, [filters, transient, version]);
  const total = (data || []).reduce((n, r) => n + r.value, 0);
  const radius = 54, circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  let offset = 0;
  return (
    <article className="board-card board-mix">
      <header><div className="board-heading"><span className="board-kicker"><ChartPie size={14} aria-hidden="true" />Sales composition</span><h3>Revenue mix</h3><p>Where recorded sales come from</p></div></header>
      {error ? (
        <p className="board-state board-error" role="alert">{error}</p>
      ) : loading && !data ? (
        <p className="board-state" role="status">Splitting revenue…</p>
      ) : !data?.length || total <= 0 ? (
        <p className="board-state" role="status">No recorded sales revenue in this period.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="board-mix-body" aria-busy={loading}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 140 140" role="img" aria-label={`Revenue by category, total ${fmt("gross_revenue", total)}`}>
            <circle cx="70" cy="70" r={radius} fill="none" stroke="var(--hairline, #e5e7eb)" strokeWidth="18" />
            {data.map((r, i) => {
              const length = (Math.max(r.value, 0) / total) * circumference;
              const el = (
                <circle key={r.label} cx="70" cy="70" r={radius} fill="none" stroke={palette[i % palette.length]} strokeWidth="18"
                  strokeDasharray={`${length} ${circumference - length}`} strokeDashoffset={-offset} transform="rotate(-90 70 70)">
                  <title>{`${r.label}: ${fmt("gross_revenue", r.value)}`}</title>
                </circle>
              );
              offset += length;
              return el;
            })}
            <text x="70" y="66" textAnchor="middle" className="board-donut-total">{fmt("gross_revenue", total)}</text>
            <text x="70" y="82" textAnchor="middle" className="board-donut-sub">sales revenue</text>
          </svg>
          <ul>
            {data.map((r, i) => (
              <li key={r.label}>
                <i style={{ background: palette[i % palette.length] }} aria-hidden="true" />
                <span title={r.label}>{r.label}</span>
                <strong className="number">{((r.value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%</strong>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

```typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { ArrowDownRight, ArrowUpRight, Building2 } from "lucide-react";
import { query } from "../../data/duckdb";
import { ensureSource } from "../../data/loader";
import { comparison, context, metricFacts } from "../../data/analytics";
import { metricSQL, metrics } from "../../semantics/metrics";
import { metricTable } from "../../semantics/catalogue";
import { fmt } from "../../semantics/formats";
import { useStore } from "../../state/store";
import { rankRows } from "../../data/overview-board";
import { useBoardData } from "./useBoardData";

const options = ["gross_revenue", "attendance", "fill_rate"];

/** Studios ranked on one metric, with change against the comparison period and a click-through filter. */
export function StudioLeaderboard({ version }: { version: string }) {
  const filters = useStore((s) => s.filters);
  const transient = useStore((s) => s.transient);
  const compare = useStore((s) => s.compare);
  const set = useStore((s) => s.set);
  const [id, setId] = useState(options[0]);
  const { data, loading, error } = useBoardData(async () => {
    const table = metricTable(id);
    if (!table) throw new Error("This metric has no source sheet.");
    await ensureSource(table);
    const run = (f: typeof filters) =>
      query(
        `SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(location AS VARCHAR)),''),'Unspecified') AS label, ${metricSQL([id], context(f, transient))} FROM ${metricFacts(f, table, transient)} GROUP BY 1`,
      );
    const [now, before] = await Promise.all([
      run(filters),
      compare === "none" ? Promise.resolve([]) : run(comparison(filters, compare)),
    ]);
    const prior = new Map(before.map((r) => [String(r.label), r[id] == null ? null : Number(r[id])]));
    return rankRows(
      now.map((r) => ({
        label: String(r.label),
        value: r[id] == null ? null : Number(r[id]),
        previous: prior.get(String(r.label)) ?? null,
      })),
      metrics[id].higherIsBetter,
    );
  }, [id, filters, transient, compare, version]);
  const max = Math.max(...(data || []).map((r) => Math.abs(r.value)), 1);
  const better = metrics[id].higherIsBetter;
  return (
    <article className="board-card board-leaderboard">
      <header>
        <div className="board-heading"><span className="board-kicker"><Building2 size={14} aria-hidden="true" />Studio comparison</span><h3>Studio leaderboard</h3><p>Ranked by the selected measure</p></div>
        <div className="board-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Leaderboard metric">
          {options.map((o) => (
            <button key={o} role="tab" aria-selected={o === id} onClick={() => setId(o)}>
              {metrics[o].label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </header>
      {error ? (
        <p className="board-state board-error" role="alert">{error}</p>
      ) : loading && !data ? (
        <p className="board-state" role="status">Ranking studios…</p>
      ) : !data?.length ? (
        <p className="board-state" role="status">No studio has {metrics[id].label.toLowerCase()} for these filters.</p>
      ) : (
        <ol aria-busy={loading}>
          {data.map((r, i) => {
            const good = r.change === null ? null : r.change >= 0 === better;
            return (
              <li key={r.label}>
                <button
                  className="board-row"
                  onClick={() => set({ filters: { ...filters, location: [r.label] } })}
                  aria-label={`Filter to ${r.label}`}
                >
                  <span className="board-rank">{i + 1}</span>
                  <span className="board-name">{r.label}</span>
                  <span className="board-bar" aria-hidden="true"><i style={{ width: `${(Math.abs(r.value) / max) * 100}%` }} /></span>
                  <strong className="number">{fmt(id, r.value)}</strong>
                  <span className={`board-delta ${good === null ? "muted" : good ? "positive" : "negative"}`}>
                    {r.change === null ? "" : r.change >= 0 ? <ArrowUpRight size={12} /> : <ArrowDownRight size={12} />}
                    {r.change === null ? "—" : `${Math.abs(r.change * 100).toFixed(1)}%`}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

```

SQL output aliases: fmt, delta

```typescript
import { controlLimits } from "../../report/statistics";
import { InsightDrilldown } from "./InsightDrilldown";
import { TrendingUp, TriangleAlert, GitBranch, Lightbulb, Radar, ArrowRightCircle, Target, Gauge, Activity, Coins, Eye, Users, CalendarClock, Crosshair, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { Row } from "../../data/duckdb";
import { InstructorName } from "../InstructorAvatar";
import { chapters } from "../../report/chapters";
import { definition, reportFmt as fmt, reportDelta as delta } from "../../report/definitions";
import type { ChapterData, GroupTable, InsightCard, InsightLens, ReportModel } from "../../report/model";
import { INSIGHT_LENSES } from "../../report/model";

const label = (id: string) => definition(id)?.label ?? id;

const LENS_ICON: Record<InsightLens, typeof TrendingUp> = { win: TrendingUp, risk: TriangleAlert, driver: GitBranch, opportunity: Lightbulb, watch: Radar, next_step: ArrowRightCircle };
const LEGACY: Record<string, InsightLens> = { red_flag: 'risk', worked: 'win', didnt_work: 'risk', meaning: 'driver', next_step: 'next_step', plain_language: 'driver' };
/** Cards written before lenses existed still render under the closest lens. */
export const lensOf = (card: InsightCard): InsightLens => card.lens ?? LEGACY[card.category ?? ''] ?? 'driver';
export const lensLabel = (lens: InsightLens) => INSIGHT_LENSES.find(l => l.id === lens)?.label ?? lens;

/** Up, down or flat, read against the metric's own direction of good. */
export function tone(id: string, value: unknown, previous: unknown) {
  if (value == null || previous == null || !Number.isFinite(Number(value)) || !Number.isFinite(Number(previous))) return "flat";
  const change = Number(value) - Number(previous);
  if (!change) return "flat";
  return (change > 0) === (definition(id)?.higherIsBetter ?? true) ? "up" : "down";
}

/** Where a metric's figures live: the card's own chapter first, then any chapter that holds it. */
export function metricSource(model: ReportModel, chapterId: string, id: string): ChapterData | undefined {
  const own = model.chapters[chapterId];
  if (own && (own.total[id] != null || own.history.some(r => r[id] != null))) return own;
  for (const spec of chapters) {
    const data = model.chapters[spec.id];
    if (data && data.total[id] != null) return data;
  }
  return undefined;
}

export function Spark({ id, history, width = 120, height = 30 }: { id: string; history: Row[]; width?: number; height?: number }) {
  const values = history.map(row => row[id] == null ? null : Number(row[id]));
  const finite = values.filter((v): v is number => v != null && Number.isFinite(v));
  if (finite.length < 2) return null;
  const peak = Math.max(...finite), floor = Math.min(...finite), span = peak - floor || Math.abs(peak) || 1;
  const x = (i: number) => 2 + i / Math.max(values.length - 1, 1) * (width - 4);
  const y = (v: number) => height - 3 - (v - floor) / span * (height - 8);
  let d = '';
  values.forEach((v, i) => { if (v != null && Number.isFinite(v)) d += `${i === 0 || values[i - 1] == null ? 'M' : 'L'}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)} `; });
  const lastIndex = values.length - 1 - [...values].reverse().findIndex(v => v != null && Number.isFinite(v));
  const last = values[lastIndex]!;
  return <svg className="r2-spark" viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} role="img" aria-label={`${label(id)} over ${history.length} months`}>
    <path d={`${d} L${x(lastIndex).toFixed(1)},${height} L${x(values.findIndex(v => v != null)).toFixed(1)},${height} Z`} className="r2-spark-area" />
    <path d={d} className="r2-spark-line" />
    <circle cx={x(lastIndex)} cy={y(last)} r="2.6" className="r2-spark-dot" />
  </svg>;
}

/** A metric with its comparisons and trajectory: the unit of evidence beside every claim. */
export function MetricChip({ id, data, target, compact = false }: { id: string; data: ChapterData; target?: number; compact?: boolean }) {
  const value = data.total[id];
  const mom = tone(id, value, data.prior[id]), yoy = tone(id, value, data.priorYear[id]);
  const hit = target == null || value == null ? null : (Number(value) >= target) === (definition(id)?.higherIsBetter ?? true);
  return <div className="r2-chip" data-tone={mom}>
    <span className="r2-chip-label">{label(id)}</span>
    <strong className="r2-chip-value">{fmt(id, value)}</strong>
    <span className="r2-chip-deltas">
      <span data-tone={mom}>MoM {delta(id, value, data.prior[id])}</span>
      <span data-tone={yoy}>YoY {delta(id, value, data.priorYear[id])}</span>
      {hit != null && <span data-tone={hit ? 'up' : 'down'}><Target size={10}/>{hit ? 'On target' : 'Below target'} {fmt(id, target)}</span>}
    </span>
    {!compact && <Spark id={id} history={data.history.slice(-12)} />}
    <button type="button" className="r-chip-explore" data-insight-toggle onClick={e => { const detail = e.currentTarget.closest('.r2-insight')?.querySelector<HTMLDetailsElement>('.r-insight-drilldown'); if (detail) detail.open = true; }} aria-label={`Explore ${label(id)} evidence`}>Explore data</button>
  </div>;
}

/** The focus breakdown, shown on its comparison measure with the rows the claim names emphasised. */
export function FocusBars({ table, highlight = [], metric }: { table: GroupTable; highlight?: string[]; metric?: string }) {
  const id = metric && table.columns.includes(metric) ? metric : table.compare ?? table.columns[0];
  const named = new Set(highlight.map(h => h.trim().toLowerCase()));
  const rows = table.rows.filter(row => row[id] != null && Number.isFinite(Number(row[id])));
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const sorted = [...rows].sort((a, b) => Number(b[id]) - Number(a[id]));
  const isNamed = (row: Row) => named.has(String(row.g ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
  const shown = [...sorted.slice(0, 6), ...sorted.slice(6).filter(isNamed)].slice(0, 9);
  const peak = Math.max(...shown.map(row => Math.abs(Number(row[id]))), 1e-9);
  const median = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
  return <figure className="r2-bars">
    <figcaption><span>{table.title}</span><small>{label(id)} · {shown.length} of {rows.length} groups{named.size ? ' · named rows highlighted' : ''}</small></figcaption>
    {shown.map((row, i) => {
      const value = Number(row[id]);
      const prior = table.prior?.[String(row.g)]?.[id];
      return <div className="r2-bar" key={String(row.g) + i} data-named={isNamed(row)}>
        <span className="r2-bar-name">{table.field === 'trainer' && !table.fields?.length ? <InstructorName name={String(row.g ?? 'Unspecified')}/> : String(row.g ?? 'Unspecified')}</span>
        <span className="r2-bar-track"><span style={{ width: `${Math.max(2, Math.abs(value) / peak * 100)}%` }} data-negative={value < 0} /></span>
        <span className="r2-bar-value">{fmt(id, value)}<small data-tone={tone(id, value, prior)}>{delta(id, value, prior)}</small></span>
      </div>;
    })}
    {median && <p className="r2-bars-note">Median group {fmt(id, median[id])}{table.total?.[id] != null ? ` · all groups ${fmt(id, table.total[id])}` : ''} · change vs previous month</p>}
  </figure>;
}

/** Monthly line for the claim's lead metric, with the selected month marked. */
export function FocusTrend({ id, history }: { id: string; history: Row[] }) {
  const values = history.map(row => row[id] == null ? null : Number(row[id]));
  const finite = values.filter((v): v is number => v != null && Number.isFinite(v));
  if (finite.length < 3) return null;
  const limits = controlLimits(values);
  const W = 360, H = 120, peak = Math.max(...finite, limits?.upper ?? -Infinity), floor = Math.min(...finite, limits?.lower ?? 0, 0), span = peak - floor || 1;
  const x = (i: number) => 34 + i / Math.max(values.length - 1, 1) * (W - 44);
  const y = (v: number) => H - 20 - (v - floor) / span * (H - 34);
  let d = '';
  values.forEach((v, i) => { if (v != null && Number.isFinite(v)) d += `${i === 0 || values[i - 1] == null ? 'M' : 'L'}${x(i).toFixed(1)},${y(v).toFixed(1)} `; });
  return <figure className="r2-trend"><figcaption><span>{label(id)}</span><small>{history.length} months · {limits ? "exploratory 3σ limits" : "control limits need 12 prior observations"}</small></figcaption>
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${W} ${H}`} role="img" aria-label={`${label(id)} monthly trend`}>
      {[floor, peak].map((v, i) => <g key={i}><line className="r2-grid" x1="34" x2={W - 10} y1={y(v)} y2={y(v)} /><text className="r2-axis" x="30" y={y(v) + 3} textAnchor="end">{fmt(id, v)}</text></g>)}
      {limits && [limits.lower, limits.mean, limits.upper].map((v,i)=><line key={`limit-${i}`} x1="34" x2={W-10} y1={y(v)} y2={y(v)} stroke="currentColor" strokeDasharray="4 4" opacity={.35}><title>{i===0?'Lower 3σ':i===1?'Baseline mean':'Upper 3σ'}: {fmt(id,v)}</title></line>)}
      <path d={d} className="r2-trend-line" />
      {values.map((v, i) => v == null ? null : <circle key={i} cx={x(i)} cy={y(v)} r={i === values.length - 1 ? 4 : 2.2} className={i === values.length - 1 ? 'r2-trend-now' : 'r2-trend-dot'}><title>{String(history[i].month)}: {fmt(id, v)}</title></circle>)}
      {history.map((row, i) => i % 3 === 0 || i === history.length - 1 ? <text key={i} className="r2-axis" x={x(i)} y={H - 4} textAnchor="middle">{String(row.month).slice(2)}</text> : null)}
    </svg></figure>;
}

function Facet({ icon: Icon, title, children, kind }: { icon: typeof Activity; title: string; children: ReactNode; kind?: string }) {
  return <section className="r2-facet" data-kind={kind}><h4><Icon size={13}/>{title}</h4><p>{children}</p></section>;
}

export function InsightBlock({ card, model, chapterId, index, inlineEvidence = true, confidence = true, plan = false, targets }: {
  card: InsightCard; model: ReportModel; chapterId: string; index: number; inlineEvidence?: boolean; confidence?: boolean; plan?: boolean; targets?: Record<string, number>;
}) {
  const lens = lensOf(card);
  const Icon = LENS_ICON[lens];
  const own = model.chapters[chapterId];
  const table = own?.groups.find(g => (g.id ?? g.field) === card.focus);
  // Older cards name no metrics: fall back to the breakdown's comparison or the chapter's lead measure.
  const cited = (card.metrics?.length ? card.metrics : [table?.compare, ...(chapters.find(c => c.id === chapterId)?.metrics ?? [])].filter((id): id is string => !!id).slice(0, 2))
    .map(id => ({ id, data: metricSource(model, chapterId, id) })).filter((m): m is { id: string; data: ChapterData } => !!m.data && m.data.total[m.id] != null).slice(0, 4);
  const lead = cited[0];
  const driver = card.driver || card.reasoning;
  const trend = card.trend || [card.monthContext, card.yearContext].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  const hasEvidence = inlineEvidence && (cited.length > 0 || !!table);
  return <article className="r2-insight" data-lens={lens} data-priority={card.priority ?? 'medium'} data-evidence={hasEvidence}>
    <div className="r2-insight-main">
      <header>
        {plan && <span className="r2-plan-no">{String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}</span>}
        <span className="r2-lens"><Icon size={13}/>{lensLabel(lens)}</span>
        {card.priority && <span className="r2-tag" data-priority={card.priority}>{card.priority} priority</span>}
        {confidence && card.confidence && <span className="r2-tag r2-confidence" title="Interpretation confidence">{card.confidence} confidence</span>}
      </header>
      <InsightDrilldown model={model} chapterId={chapterId} headline={card.headline} metrics={cited} table={table}>{card.headline}</InsightDrilldown>
      {card.meaning && <p className="r2-meaning">{card.meaning}</p>}
      <div className="r2-facets">
        {driver && <Facet icon={GitBranch} title={plan ? 'Why this move' : 'Root cause'}>{plan && card.recommendation ? card.recommendation : driver}</Facet>}
        {card.concentration && !plan && <Facet icon={Crosshair} title="Where it concentrates">{card.concentration}</Facet>}
        {card.offset && !plan && <Facet icon={ShieldCheck} title="What held up" kind="offset">{card.offset}</Facet>}
        {trend && !plan && <Facet icon={Activity} title="Structural or one-off?">{trend}</Facet>}
        {card.impact && <Facet icon={Coins} title="Value at stake" kind="impact">{card.impact}</Facet>}
      </div>
      {(card.action || (plan && card.recommendation && !driver)) && <div className="r2-move">
        <h4><ArrowRightCircle size={14}/>{plan ? 'The move' : 'Recommended move'}</h4>
        <p>{card.action || card.recommendation}</p>
        {(card.ownerArea || card.horizon) && <div className="r2-move-meta">{card.ownerArea && <span><Users size={12}/>{card.ownerArea}</span>}{card.horizon && <span><CalendarClock size={12}/>{card.horizon}</span>}</div>}
      </div>}
      {card.watch && <p className="r2-watch"><Eye size={13}/><b>Signal to watch</b> {card.watch}</p>}
    </div>
    {hasEvidence && <aside className="r2-evidence" aria-label="Supporting evidence">
      <span className="r2-evidence-title"><Gauge size={12}/>Evidence</span>
      {card.evidence && <p className="r2-evidence-text">{card.evidence}</p>}
      {!!cited.length && <div className="r2-chips">{cited.map(m => <MetricChip key={m.id} id={m.id} data={m.data} target={targets?.[m.id]} compact={cited.length > 2} />)}</div>}
      {table ? <FocusBars table={table} highlight={card.highlight} metric={card.metrics?.find(id => table.columns.includes(id))} />
        : lead && (card.focus === 'trend' || cited.length <= 2) ? <FocusTrend id={lead.id} history={lead.data.history.slice(-14)} /> : null}
    </aside>}
  </article>;
}

/** Measures leadership most often sets a monthly target for. Rates are entered as percentages. */
const TARGETS_KEY = 'atlas-report-targets';
function storedTargets(): Record<string, number> {
  try { const parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(TARGETS_KEY) || '{}'); return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {}; }
  catch { return {}; }
}

/** Presentation and editorial choices persist per browser; identity and chapter scope are per report. */

  catch { return {}; }
}

const clock = (seconds: number) => `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(Math.max(0, seconds) % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;

function openInNewTab(model: ReportModel) {
  if (model.id) { window.open(`/report?id=${encodeURIComponent(model.id)}`, "_blank", "noopener"); return Promise.resolve(); }
  return openReportPage(document.body, model);
}

  const theme = useStore((s) => s.theme);
  const filters = useStore((s) => s.filters);
  const reportTheme = themeOptions.find((option) => option.id === theme)?.type.startsWith("Dark") ? "dark" : "light";
  const job = useReportJob();

    detail: 'Comprehensive', instructions: '', chapterIds: chapters.map(c => c.id), theme: reportTheme, targets: storedTargets(),
    density: 'comfortable', layout: 'adaptive', evidenceView: 'auto', historyMonths: 12, accent: 'navy', focusAreas: [], ...storedPreferences(),

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);

    const appearance = ['title','subtitle','preparedFor','preparedBy','theme','surface','density','layout','evidenceView','historyMonths','accent','typography','cardStyle','confidentiality','showCover','showGlance','showContents','showInlineEvidence','showActionPlan','showCharts','showDefinitions','showConfidence','showSources','showAppendix','pageBreaks','chapterIds'];
    // Presentation changes restyle the open report without rewriting it; it becomes an unsaved variant.
    const restyled = model && !running && Object.keys(value).every(key => appearance.includes(key))
      ? { ...model, customization: { ...customization, ...model.customization, ...value }, id: undefined, savedAt: undefined } : model;
    job.set({ customization: next, model: restyled });

  const [localError, setLocalError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void (async () => {
      try {
        const [locationRows, monthRows] = await Promise.all([
          query(`SELECT DISTINCT location FROM sessions WHERE location IS NOT NULL ORDER BY location`),
          query(`SELECT DISTINCT month FROM sessions WHERE month IS NOT NULL ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 36`),
        ]);
        if (!live) return;
        const locations = locationRows.map((r) => String(r.location));
        const available = monthRows.map((r) => String(r.month));
        setStudios(locations);
        setMonths(available);

        state.set({

"Rewriting analysis" : "Generating report" : status === "stopped" ? "Stopped · completed chapters retained" : job.storageError ? "Save failed · report retained" : job.narrativeError ? "Partial analysis · review required" : model ? model.id ? "Report saved" : "Unsaved report" : "Ready to build"}</span></header>

      <div className="rs-grid">

            {error && <p className="notice" role="alert"><TriangleAlert size={13} />{error}</p>}

              {!model.id && <button className="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void persistReport(model)}><Database size={14}/>{status === "stopped" ? "Save partial" : "Save"}</button>}
              <button className="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => job.set({ model: null, status: "idle", narrativeError: "", error: "", storageError: "" })}><FilePlus2 size={14}/>New</button>
            </div>

          </section>}

          <section className="rs-card rs-library" aria-label="Report library">
            <header className="rs-card-head"><History size={16}/><div><h3>Report library</h3><p>Latest {KEEP_RECENT} reports plus pinned. Older unpinned reports are removed.</p></div></header>

            {!loadingHistory && !job.savedReports.length && <p className="rs-empty"><FileText size={18}/>Generated reports appear here.</p>}
            {[["Pinned", pinned], ["Recent", recent]].map(([title, items]) => (items as typeof recent).length ? <div className="rs-library-group" key={title as string}>
              <span className="rs-library-label">{title as string}</span>
              <ul>{(items as typeof recent).map(item => <li key={item.id} data-current={item.id === model?.id}>
                <button className="rs-library-open" onClick={() => void open(item.id)} title="Open in new tab">
                  <span className="rs-library-icon"><FileText size={15}/></span>
                  <span><b>{item.scope.studio} · {monthLabel(item.scope.month)}</b><small>{item.title && !/^monthly performance report$/i.test(item.title) ? `${item.title} · ` : ""}{when(item.editedAt || item.savedAt)}{item.editedAt ? " · edited" : ""} · {item.imported ? `${item.chapterCount} source chapters` : `${item.aiChapters}/${item.chapterCount ?? 0} AI`}</small></span>
                  <ArrowUpRight size={14}/>
                </button>
                <button className="icon-button" aria-label={item.pinned ? "Unpin report" : "Pin report"} title={item.pinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin to keep"} aria-pressed={!!item.pinned} onClick={() => void togglePin(item.id, !item.pinned)}>{item.pinned ? <PinOff size={14}/> : <Pin size={14}/>}</button>
                <button className="icon-button" aria-label="Load settings into builder" title="Load into builder" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void loadIntoBuilder(item.id)}><RefreshCw size={13}/></button>
              </li>)}</ul></div> : null)}
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
      {model && <section className="rs-report-preview" aria-label="Monthly report preview">
        <header><div><span className="eyebrow">Your studio review</span><h2>{model.scope.studio} · {monthLabel(model.scope.month)}</h2><p>{running ? "Chapters appear as their analysis completes." : "Frozen monthly figures · source links identify whether records are frozen or live."}</p></div><button className="button" onClick={() => void open(model)} disabled={busy}><ExternalLink size={14}/>Open reader</button></header>
        {(studio !== model.scope.studio || month !== model.scope.month) && <p className="notice">This preview is {model.scope.studio} · {monthLabel(model.scope.month)}. Generate a report to apply the newly selected scope.</p>}
        <ReportAssistant model={model} onChange={next => job.set({ model: next })} inline/>
        <article className="report-doc r2 deck deck-doc cr-inline p57-report-surface" style={reportAppearance(model)} data-report-theme={model.customization?.theme || "light"} data-accent={reportOptions(model.customization).accent} data-surface={reportOptions(model.customization).surface} data-report-layout={reportOptions(model.customization).layout} data-typography={reportOptions(model.customization).typography} data-density={reportOptions(model.customization).density}>
          {model.importedChapters?.length ? <ImportedReport model={model}/> : <ContinuousReport withNavigation model={model} tabs={previewTabs} ranked={previewFindings} onNavigate={id => document.getElementById(`chapter-${id}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" })}/>}
        </article>
      </section>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Shown outside the Monthly report tab while a run is writing, or once it finishes unseen. */
export function ReportJobIndicator({ onOpen }: { onOpen: () => void }) {
  const { status, stage, unseen, model, pending } = useReportJob();
  if (status !== "running" && !unseen) return null;
  const total = model?.customization?.chapterIds.length ?? 0;
  const progress = stage && stage.total ? Math.round((stage.done / stage.total) * 100) : 0;
  return <div className="rb2-indicator" role="status" data-state={status}>
    {status === "running" ? <Loader2 size={15} className="rb2-spin"/> : status === "done" ? <CheckCircle2 size={15}/> : <TriangleAlert size={15}/>}
    <div>
      <strong>{status === "running" ? "Writing monthly report" : status === "done" ? "Monthly report ready" : status === "stopped" ? "Report generation stopped" : "Report generation hit a problem"}</strong>
      <span>{status === "running" ? `${model ? `${total - pending.length}/${total} chapters` : stage?.label ?? "Starting"} · ${progress}%` : model ? `${model.scope.studio} · ${monthLabel(model.scope.month)}` : ""}</span>
    </div>
    <button className="button" onClick={() => { useReportJob.getState().set({ unseen: false }); onOpen(); }}>View</button>
    {status === "running" ? <button className="button" aria-label="Stop report generation" onClick={stopReport}><Square size={12}/>Stop</button>
      : <button className="button" aria-label="Dismiss" onClick={() => useReportJob.getState().set({ unseen: false })}>×</button>}
  </div>;
}

export type { ReportModel };

"Return to saved report rows" : "View current source rows instead"}</button></p>}

'The saved evidence contains no matching rows.' : 'Live source data may have changed since report generation.'}</p> : <>

      <div className="table-scroll monthly-table compact deck-explorer-table dk-x-table" tabIndex={0}>

"record" : "records"} · {(g.rows.length / filtered.length * 100).toFixed(1)}%</small></button></th>
              {columns.filter(c => c !== group).map(c => <td key={c} data-num={numeric.includes(c) || undefined}>{numeric.includes(c) ? <><b>{formatField(c, sum(g.rows, c))}</b><small>avg {formatField(c, sum(g.rows, c) / g.rows.length)}</small></> : <small>{new Set(g.rows.map(r => r[c])).size} distinct</small>}</td>)}</tr>
            {!!limit && <>{g.rows.slice(0, limit).map(line)}{g.rows.length > limit && <tr className="dk-x-more"><td colSpan={columns.length + 1}><button type="button" className="button" onClick={() => setOpen(o => ({ ...o, [g.name]: limit + GROUP_ROWS }))}>Show {Math.min(GROUP_ROWS, g.rows.length - limit)} more of {g.rows.length - limit}</button></td></tr>}</>}

'Frozen source snapshot saved with this report at' : 'Current source data; report figures frozen at'} {new Date(model.builtAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", { day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric" })}{frozenPeriod ? '. These records are frozen with the report.' : ' and may differ if the sheet changed since.'}</p>
    </>)}

}

import { useId, useRef, type CSSProperties } from "react";
import { ArrowDownRight, ArrowUpRight, Minus, RotateCcw, Target, ChartColumnBig } from "lucide-react";
import { useMetricFlipState } from "../../MetricFlip";
import { Sparkline } from "../../Sparkline";
import { definition, reportFmt as fmt, reportDelta as delta } from "../../../report/definitions";
import { monthLabel, monthShort } from "../../../report/period";
import { currentSnapshotMetrics } from "../../../semantics/evidence";
import type { ChapterData } from "../../../report/model";
import { axisStyle, chartPalette, tooltipStyle, useChart } from "./useChart";
import { useRecordDrilldown } from "./RecordDrilldown";

const direction = (id: string, value: unknown, prior: unknown) => {
  if (value == null || prior == null || Number(value) === Number(prior)) return "flat";
  return (Number(value) > Number(prior)) === (definition(id)?.higherIsBetter ?? true) ? "positive" : "negative";
};

/** Fourteen months of one measure, the selected month highlighted, with a 3-month rolling line. */
/** Clicking a bar opens that month's records; `onDrill` lets the card skip its own flip for that click. */
function MetricHistoryChart({ id, data, active, onDrill }: { id: string; data: ChapterData; active: boolean; onDrill: () => void }) {
  const history = data.history.slice(-14);
  const drill = useRecordDrilldown();
  const { ref } = useChart(() => {
    if (!active) return null;
    const c = chartPalette(), axis = axisStyle();
    const values = history.map(r => r[id] == null ? null : Number(r[id]));
    const rolling = values.map((_, i) => { const w = values.slice(Math.max(0, i - 2), i + 1).filter((v): v is number => v != null); return w.length === 3 ? w.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / 3 : null; });
    return {
      grid: { left: 4, right: 4, top: 12, bottom: 2, containLabel: true },
      tooltip: { trigger: "axis", ...tooltipStyle(), valueFormatter: (v: unknown) => fmt(id, v) },
      xAxis: { type: "category", data: history.map(r => monthShort(String(r.month))), ...axis, axisLabel: { ...axis.axisLabel, interval: "auto", hideOverlap: true } },
      yAxis: { type: "value", ...axis, axisLine: { show: false }, axisLabel: { ...axis.axisLabel, formatter: (v: number) => fmt(id, v) }, splitNumber: 2 },
      series: [
        // Past months recede; the report month carries the accent and a direct label.
        { type: "bar", name: definition(id)?.label ?? id, barMaxWidth: 14, data: values.map((v, i) => { const last = i === values.length - 1; return { value: v, itemStyle: { color: last ? c.accent : c.hairline, borderRadius: [3, 3, 0, 0] },
          label: last ? { show: true, position: "top", color: c.text1, fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 600, formatter: () => fmt(id, v) } : undefined }; }) },
        { type: "line", name: "3-month average", data: rolling, smooth: true, symbol: "none", lineStyle: { width: 1.25, color: c.text3 } },
      ],
    };
  }, [id, active, history.length], params => { const month = String(history[params.dataIndex]?.month ?? ""); if (month && drill) { onDrill(); drill({ month, metric: id, chapterId: data.id }); } });
  return <div className="deck-flip-chart" ref={ref} role="img" aria-label={`${definition(id)?.label} over ${history.length} months`} />;
}

/** The app's metric card; clicking flips it to its 14-month history. */
export function FlipMetricCard({ id, data, target }: { id: string; data: ChapterData; target?: number; flipped: boolean; onToggle: () => void }) {
  const drill = useRecordDrilldown();
  const m = definition(id);
  const value = data.total[id], prior = data.prior[id], lastYear = data.priorYear[id];
  const mom = direction(id, value, prior), yoy = direction(id, value, lastYear);
  const values = data.history.slice(-14).map(r => r[id] == null ? null : Number(r[id]));
  const finite = values.filter((v): v is number => v != null && Number.isFinite(v));
  const hit = target == null || value == null ? null : (Number(value) >= target) === (m?.higherIsBetter ?? true);
  const Arrow = mom === "flat" ? Minus : Number(value) >= Number(prior) ? ArrowUpRight : ArrowDownRight;
  const YearArrow = yoy === "flat" ? Minus : Number(value) >= Number(lastYear) ? ArrowUpRight : ArrowDownRight;
  const flipKey = useId();
  const [flipped, toggle] = useMetricFlipState(flipKey);
  const drilled = useRef(false);
  return <div className="deck-flip" data-flipped={flipped}
    style={{ "--card-accent": `var(--accent, var(--${m?.domain ?? "accent"}))` } as CSSProperties}>
    <div className="deck-flip-inner">
      {!flipped ? <article className="deck-kpi deck-flip-face deck-flip-front" role="button" tabIndex={0} aria-pressed={false} aria-label={`${m?.label}: ${fmt(id, value)}. Show 14-month history`}
        title="Click for 14 months of history" onClick={() => toggle()} onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); } }}>
        <div className="deck-kpi-label"><span title={m?.label}>{m?.label ?? id}</span><ChartColumnBig size={13} aria-hidden="true" className="deck-flip-hint"/></div>
        <div className="deck-kpi-reading">
          <span className="deck-kpi-value">{value == null ? "Unavailable" : fmt(id, value)}</span>
          <Sparkline values={values} color="var(--accent)" />
        </div>
        <div className="deck-kpi-comparisons"><span className={`deck-kpi-delta metric-delta ${mom === "flat" ? "muted" : mom}`} title="Month on month"><Arrow size={12}/>{delta(id, value, prior)}<small>MoM</small></span><span className={`deck-kpi-delta metric-delta ${yoy === "flat" ? "muted" : yoy}`} title="Year on year"><YearArrow size={12}/>{delta(id, value, lastYear)}<small>YoY</small></span></div>
        <div className="deck-kpi-foot">
          {hit != null ? <span className={`deck-target ${hit ? "positive" : "negative"}`}><Target size={11}/>{hit ? "On target" : "Below"} {fmt(id, target)}</span>
            : <span>{currentSnapshotMetrics.has(id) ? "Snapshot" : m?.aggregation === "sum" ? "Total" : "Weighted"}</span>}
        </div>
      </article> : <article className="deck-kpi deck-flip-face deck-flip-back" title="Click a bar for its records; click elsewhere to flip back" onClick={() => { if (drilled.current) drilled.current = false; else toggle(); }}>
        <div className="deck-kpi-label"><span>{m?.label ?? id} · 14 months</span>
          <button className="icon-button" aria-label="Flip back" tabIndex={flipped ? 0 : -1} onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); toggle(); }}><RotateCcw size={13}/></button></div>
        <MetricHistoryChart id={id} data={data} active={flipped} onDrill={() => { drilled.current = true; }} />
        {finite.length > 1 && <dl className="deck-flip-stats">
          <div><dt>Low</dt><dd>{fmt(id, Math.min(...finite))}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>High</dt><dd>{fmt(id, Math.max(...finite))}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Avg</dt><dd>{fmt(id, finite.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / finite.length)}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>{monthLabel(String(data.history.at(-1)?.month ?? "")).split(" ")[0] || "Latest"}</dt><dd>{fmt(id, value)}</dd></div>
        </dl>}
        {drill && <button type="button" className="p57-metric-records" data-export="omit" onClick={event => { event.stopPropagation(); drill({ metric: id, chapterId: data.id }); }}>View item-level records ↗</button>}
        <dl className="deck-flip-stats">
          <div><dt>Previous month</dt><dd>{fmt(id, prior)}</dd></div>
          <div><dt>Last year</dt><dd>{fmt(id, lastYear)}</dd></div>
          {Object.keys(data.total).filter(key => key !== id && definition(key)?.domain === m?.domain && definition(key) && data.total[key] != null && !key.includes("__")).slice(0, 2).map(key => <div key={key}><dt>{definition(key)?.label}</dt><dd>{fmt(key, data.total[key])}</dd></div>)}
        </dl>
      </article>}
    </div>
    {!flipped && drill && <button type="button" className="p57-metric-records" data-export="omit" aria-label={`View ${m?.label ?? id} item-level records`} onClick={() => drill({ metric: id, chapterId: data.id })}>View records ↗</button>}
  </div>;
}

export function LeadershipFront({ model, exporting = false }: { model: ReportModel; exporting?: boolean }) {

  const seen = new Set<string>();

    if (!definition(id) || seen.has(id) || !['gross_revenue','transactions','attendance','fill_rate','lead_conversion_rate'].includes(id)) return false;
    seen.add(id); return true;
  }).map(id => ({id,data})));

    <header><span className="deck-eyebrow">Leadership decision brief · {model.scope.month}</span><h1>{model.scope.studio} · {monthLabel(model.scope.month)}</h1><p>Physique 57 India · Business Performance Review</p><p>Evidence frozen {model.builtAt.slice(0,10)} · {issues.length ? 'Draft · quality gate blocked' : 'Quality gate passed'}</p></header>
    <section className="p57-executive-verdict" aria-label="Executive performance verdict"><h2>Executive performance verdict</h2><ReportProse text={model.narratives['executive-summary']?.summary}/></section>
    {cards.length < 3 && <p role="status">Awaiting three to five complete leadership verdicts.</p>}
    {[
      { title: 'What worked well', items: cards.filter(c => lensOf(c) === 'win') },
      { title: "What did not work / risks to address", items: cards.filter(c => lensOf(c) === 'risk') },
      { title: 'Decisions and opportunities', items: cards.filter(c => !['win', 'risk'].includes(lensOf(c))) },
    ].filter(group => group.items.length).map(group => <section key={group.title}><h2>{group.title}</h2><ol className="leadership-verdicts">{group.items.map((c,i)=><li key={i}><h3>{c.headline}</h3><p><b>So what:</b> {c.meaning}</p><p><b>Why:</b> {c.driver || c.evidence}</p><p><b>Action:</b> {c.action} <strong>Proposed owner: {c.ownerArea || 'Unassigned'}</strong></p></li>)}</ol></section>)}
    <div className="intelligence-scroll"><table><caption>KPI scorecard against approved targets</caption><thead><tr><th>KPI</th><th>Actual</th><th>Target</th><th>RAG</th></tr></thead><tbody>{scorecard.map(({id,data})=>{
      const target=model.customization?.targets?.[id],actual=data.total[id],known=actual!=null&&Number.isFinite(Number(actual));
      const favorable=known&&target!=null&&((Number(actual)>=target)===(definition(id)?.higherIsBetter??true));
      const gap=known&&target!=null?Math.abs(Number(actual)-target)/Math.max(Math.abs(target),.000001):null;
      const rag=!known||target==null?'Unrated':favorable?'Green':gap!=null&&gap<=.1?'Amber':'Red';
      return <tr key={id}><th>{definition(id)?.label}</th><td>{known && !exporting && drill ? <button type="button" className="p57-data-link" aria-label={`View ${definition(id)?.label} scorecard records`} onClick={() => drill({ chapterId: data.id, metric: id })}>{reportFmt(id,actual)}</button> : known ? reportFmt(id,actual) : 'Unavailable'}</td><td>{target==null?'Not set':reportFmt(id,target)}</td><td data-rag={rag}>{rag}</td></tr>;
    })}{bridge && <><tr><th>Closing paid active members</th><td>{bridge[4]}</td><td>Not set</td><td data-rag="Unrated">Unrated</td></tr><tr><th>Whole-base monthly logo churn</th><td>{typeof bridge[5]==='number'?`${(bridge[5]*100).toFixed(1)}%`:'Unavailable'}</td><td>Not set</td><td data-rag="Unrated">Unrated</td></tr></>}</tbody></table></div><small>Green: target met. Amber: adverse gap up to 10% of target. Red: larger adverse gap. Missing target or evidence is Unrated.</small>
  </section>;
}

export function IntelligenceAppendix({ model }: { model: ReportModel }) {
  const intelligence=model.intelligence;
  if(!intelligence)return <p className="notice">Regenerate this report to calculate fixed-window cohorts, revenue quality, member-base and operational controls from one frozen source snapshot.</p>;

    <h3>Evidence required to complete the picture</h3><ul>{intelligence.unavailable.map(note=><li key={note}>{note}</li>)}</ul>

}

import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import type { ReportModel } from '../../../report/model';
import type { DeckTab } from '../../../report/deck';
import { READER_DEFAULTS, readerIdentity, readerPreferences, type ReaderPreferences } from '../../../report/reader';

export const ReaderContext = createContext<{ command: { expand: boolean; revision: number } | null }>({ command: null });
export const useReaderContext = () => useContext(ReaderContext);
const PREFS_KEY = 'atlas-report-reader:v1';

export function useReaderPreferences() {
  const [preferences, setPreferences] = useState<ReaderPreferences>(() => {
    try { return readerPreferences(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PREFS_KEY) || 'null')); } catch { return READER_DEFAULTS; }
  });
  useEffect(() => {
    try { localStorage.setItem(PREFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(preferences)); } catch { /* Optional browser preference. */ }
  }, [preferences]);
  function update(patch: Partial<ReaderPreferences>) {
    setPreferences(current => readerPreferences({ ...current, ...patch }));
  }
  return { preferences, update };
}

export function ReaderControls({ model, tabs, root, preferences, onPreferences, onEvidence }: {
  model: ReportModel; tabs: DeckTab[]; root: RefObject<HTMLDivElement>; preferences: ReaderPreferences;
  onPreferences: (patch: Partial<ReaderPreferences>) => void; onEvidence: (expand: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [active, setActive] = useState('overview');
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [resume, setResume] = useState('');
  const [searchOpen, setSearchOpen] = useState(false);
  const currentSection = useRef('overview');
  const key = `atlas-report-position:v1:${readerIdentity(model)}`;
  const sections = useMemo(() => [{ id: 'overview', label: 'Executive overview' }, ...tabs.filter(tab => tab.id !== 'overview').map(tab => ({ id: tab.id, label: tab.label }))], [tabs]);
  const entries = useMemo(() => tabs.flatMap(tab => {
    const narrative = model.narratives[tab.chapter];
    return [{ id: `chapter-${tab.id}`, label: tab.id === 'overview' ? 'Executive overview' : tab.title, text: narrative?.summary ?? '' }, ...(narrative?.cards ?? []).map((card, index) => ({ id: `finding-${tab.chapter}-${index}`, label: card.headline, text: [card.meaning, card.evidence, card.driver, card.action, card.recommendation].filter(Boolean).join(' '), fallback: `chapter-${tab.id}` }))];
  }), [model, tabs]);
  const needle = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  const matches = needle ? entries.filter(entry => `${entry.label} ${entry.text}`.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(needle)) : [];
  function go(id: string, fallback?: string) {
    const target = root.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`) ?? (fallback ? root.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[id="${CSS.escape(fallback)}"]`) : null);
    if (!target) return;
    target.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
    target.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    setSearchOpen(false);
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(key) || '';
      setResume(sections.some(section => section.id === saved) ? saved : '');
    } catch { setResume(''); }
    const element = root.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const scroller = element.closest<HTMLElement>('.deck-main');
    const surface: HTMLElement | Window = scroller ?? window;
    let frame = 0;
    function measure() {
      frame = 0;
      const top = scroller ? scroller.getBoundingClientRect().top : 0;
      const height = scroller?.clientHeight ?? innerHeight;
      const bounds = element!.getBoundingClientRect();
      const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (top - bounds.top) / Math.max(1, bounds.height - height)));
      setProgress(Math.round(ratio * 100));
      const chapterElements = Array.from(element!.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-reader-chapter]'));
      const current = chapterElements.filter(chapter => chapter.getBoundingClientRect().top <= top + 150).at(-1)?.dataset.readerChapter || 'overview';
      setActive(current);
      if (currentSection.current !== current) {
        currentSection.current = current;
        try { localStorage.setItem(key, current); } catch { /* Optional resume only. */ }
      }
    }
    const request = () => { if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(measure); };
    surface.addEventListener('scroll', request, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('resize', request);
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(request); observer.observe(element);
    request();
    return () => { surface.removeEventListener('scroll', request); window.removeEventListener('resize', request); observer.disconnect(); cancelAnimationFrame(frame); };
  }, [key, root, sections]); // Scroll never rewrites report data.
  return <aside className="p57-reader-tools" aria-label="Report reading tools" data-export="omit">
    <div className="p57-reader-main">
      <label>Chapter<select aria-label="Jump to report chapter" value={active} onChange={event => go(`chapter-${event.target.value}`)}>{sections.map(section => <option key={section.id} value={section.id}>{section.label}</option>)}</select></label>
      <div className="p57-reader-search"><label>Search report<input type="search" aria-label="Search report analysis" value={query} placeholder="Find a finding or phrase…" onChange={event => { setQuery(event.target.value); setSearchOpen(true); }} onFocus={() => setSearchOpen(true)} onKeyDown={event => { if (event.key === 'Escape') setSearchOpen(false); }}/></label>
      {needle && searchOpen && <div className="p57-reader-results" role="region" aria-label="Report search results"><p role="status">{matches.length} matching sections / findings</p>{matches.slice(0, 12).map((match, index) => <button type="button" key={`${match.id}:${index}`} onClick={() => go(match.id, 'fallback' in match ? match.fallback : undefined)}><b>{match.label}</b><small>{match.text.slice(0, 140)}{match.text.length > 140 ? '…' : ''}</small></button>)}{matches.length > 12 && <p>Refine the search to see more specific results.</p>}</div>}</div>
      {resume && resume !== 'overview' && <button type="button" className="p57-reader-button" onClick={() => go(`chapter-${resume}`)}>Resume reading</button>}
      <span className="p57-reader-progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Report reading progress" aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={100} aria-valuenow={progress}>{progress}% read</span>
      <details className="p57-reader-settings"><summary>Reading settings</summary><div>
        <label>Layout<select aria-label="Reading layout" value={preferences.layout} onChange={event => onPreferences({ layout: event.target.value as ReaderPreferences['layout'] })}><option value="adaptive">Adaptive · 1 or 2 per row</option><option value="single">Single column</option></select></label>
        <label>Text size<select aria-label="Reading text size" value={preferences.textSize} onChange={event => onPreferences({ textSize: event.target.value as ReaderPreferences['textSize'] })}><option value="small">Small</option><option value="standard">Standard</option><option value="large">Large</option></select></label>
        <label>Spacing<select aria-label="Reading spacing" value={preferences.spacing} onChange={event => onPreferences({ spacing: event.target.value as ReaderPreferences['spacing'] })}><option value="compact">Compact</option><option value="comfortable">Comfortable</option></select></label>
        <div className="p57-reader-actions"><button type="button" onClick={() => onEvidence(true)}>Expand supporting evidence</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onEvidence(false)}>Collapse supporting evidence</button><button type="button" onClick={() => onPreferences(READER_DEFAULTS)}>Reset reading settings</button></div>
      </div></details>
    </div>
    <div className="p57-reader-progress-track" aria-hidden="true"><i style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}/></div>
  </aside>;
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type PointerEvent } from "react";
import { Mic, Sparkles, Loader2, Timer, Play, Pause, RotateCcw, X, ExternalLink, AArrowUp, AArrowDown, MessageCircleQuestion, Hash, ArrowRight, NotebookPen, ScrollText, ChevronRight, Quote } from "lucide-react";
import type { ReportModel, SpeakerNotes } from "../../../report/model";
import { deckPages, liveNotes, pageKey, sectionContext, SECTION_LABEL, type DeckSection, type DeckTab } from "../../../report/deck";
import { generateSpeakerNotes, saveNotes } from "../../../report/storage";

import { reportFmt } from "../../../report/definitions";
import { useSpeechFollow } from "./useSpeechFollow";
const clock = (s: number) => `${String(Math.floor(s / 60)).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")}`;
const FONT_KEY = "atlas-speaker-font";

/** The presenter's script for whatever page is on screen; follows navigation automatically. */
export function SpeakerNotesView({ notes, fontScale, teleprompter, speed = 20, activeLine = -1, voice = false }: { notes: SpeakerNotes; fontScale: number; teleprompter: boolean; speed?: number; activeLine?: number; voice?: boolean }) {
  const body = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!teleprompter || voice || !body.current) return;
    const el = body.current; el.scrollTop = 0;
    const id = setInterval(() => { el.scrollTop += speed / 20; }, 50);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [teleprompter, notes, speed, voice]);
  useEffect(() => { if (voice && activeLine >= 0) body.current?.querySelector(`[data-script-line="${activeLine}"]`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center', behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }); }, [activeLine, voice]);
  return <div className="deck-notes-body" data-prompter={teleprompter} ref={body} style={{ "--notes-scale": fontScale } as React.CSSProperties}>
    <p className="deck-notes-opener" data-script-line={0} data-active={activeLine === 0}><Quote size={14}/>{notes.opener}</p>
    {!!notes.points.length && <section><h4><ScrollText size={13}/>Talking points</h4><ol className="deck-notes-points">{notes.points.map((p, i) => <li key={i} data-script-line={i + 1} data-active={activeLine === i + 1}><span>{i + 1}</span>{p}</li>)}</ol></section>}
    {!!notes.numbers.length && <section><h4><Hash size={13}/>Numbers to say aloud</h4><ul className="deck-notes-numbers">{notes.numbers.map((n, i) => <li key={i} data-script-line={notes.points.length + i + 1} data-active={activeLine === notes.points.length + i + 1}>{n}</li>)}</ul></section>}
    {!!notes.questions.length && <section><h4><MessageCircleQuestion size={13}/>Likely questions</h4>{notes.questions.map((q, i) => <details key={i} className="deck-notes-qa"><summary><ChevronRight size={13}/>{q.q}</summary><p>{q.a}</p></details>)}</section>}
    {notes.transition && <p className="deck-notes-transition" data-script-line={notes.points.length + notes.numbers.length + 1} data-active={activeLine === notes.points.length + notes.numbers.length + 1}><ArrowRight size={13}/>{notes.transition}</p>}
  </div>;
}

export function SpeakerDrawer({ model, tabs, tab, section, open, onClose, onNotes, onNavigate }: {

    setVisibleSection('');update();root.addEventListener('scroll',update,{passive:true});return()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(frame);root.removeEventListener('scroll',update);};
  },[tab,section,model.importedChapters]);
  const notes = useMemo(() => {
    const source=model.importedChapters?.find(c=>c.id===tab);
    if(!source)return liveNotes(model,tabs,tab,section);
    const current=source.sections?.find(s=>`${tab}-${s.id}`===visibleSection);
    const clean=(text:string)=>{const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'text/html');return (doc.body.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();};
    const doc=current?new DOMParser().parseFromString(current.html || '','text/html'):null;
    const paragraphs=doc?Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll('p,.sr-sub')).filter(p=>!p.closest('table,details,figure')).map(p=>clean(p.innerHTML)).filter(Boolean):[];
    const prose=paragraphs.length?paragraphs.slice(0,4):current?.blocks?.filter(b=>b.kind==='text').map(b=>b.text || '').filter(Boolean).slice(0,4) || [source.summary || source.title];
    const points=prose.filter((p):p is string=>!!p).map(p=>p.match(/^.*?[.!?](?:\s|$)/)?.[0]?.trim() || p);
    const numbers=current?[]:source.metrics?.filter(m=>m.metricId&&m.dataChapterId).slice(0,8).map(m=>`${m.label}: ${reportFmt(m.metricId!,model.chapters[m.dataChapterId!]?.total[m.metricId!])}. September 2026.`) || [];
    return {opener:`${current?.title || source.title}. ${points[0] || source.summary}`,points:[...points.slice(1),current?'Point to the evidence beside this section. Read its period and definition before comparing values.':'Explain the September headline cards first, then walk through the findings below.'],numbers,questions:[],transition:current?'Pause for questions on this finding before moving to the next section.':'Move down to the first finding.'};
  }, [model, tabs, tab, section,visibleSection]);

  const pace = elapsed / Math.max(1, target * 60) - (position + 1) / Math.max(1, pages.length);

    <div className="deck-notes-resize" role="separator" aria-label="Resize notes sidebar" aria-orientation="vertical" tabIndex={0} onPointerDown={startResize} onPointerMove={moveResize} onPointerUp={endResize} onPointerCancel={endResize} onKeyDown={e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='ArrowRight'){e.preventDefault();setDrawerWidth(w=>Math.max(260,Math.min(900,w+(e.key==='ArrowLeft'?20:-20))));}}}/>
    <div className="deck-notes-resize-corner" aria-label="Resize notes from corner" onPointerDown={startResize} onPointerMove={moveResize} onPointerUp={endResize} onPointerCancel={endResize}/>
    <button className="icon-button deck-notes-close" aria-label="Close speaker notes" onClick={onClose}><X size={16}/></button>
    <details className="deck-notes-setup"><summary><ChevronRight size={13}/>{tabLabel} · Notes settings</summary>
    <header className="deck-drawer-head">
      <div><span className="deck-eyebrow"><Mic size={12}/>Speaker notes · live</span><h3>{tabLabel} <ChevronRight size={13}/> {SECTION_LABEL[section]}</h3><small>Page {position + 1} of {pages.length}{model.speakerNotes?.[key] ? " · AI talk track" : " · from the report"}</small></div>
      <button className="icon-button" aria-label="Close speaker notes" onClick={onClose}><X size={16}/></button>
    </header>
    <div className="deck-drawer-timer" data-pace={pace > .05 ? "behind" : pace < -.05 ? "ahead" : "on"}>
      <Timer size={14}/><strong>{clock(elapsed)}</strong><span>page {clock(onPage)} / {clock(budget)}</span>
      <button className="icon-button" aria-label={running ? "Pause timer" : "Start timer"} onClick={() => setRunning(!running)}>{running ? <Pause size={14}/> : <Play size={14}/>}</button>

    </section>
    </details>
    {view === "script" ? <>
      <SpeakerNotesView notes={notes} fontScale={fontScale} teleprompter={teleprompter} speed={speed} voice={speech.listening} activeLine={speech.activeLine} />
      <div className="deck-drawer-ai">
        <button className="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void writeWithAI()}>{busy ? <Loader2 size={14} className="rb2-spin"/> : <Sparkles size={14}/>}{model.speakerNotes?.[key] ? "Rewrite talk track" : "Write talk track with AI"}</button>
        {model.speakerNotes?.[key] && <button className="button" onClick={resetAI}>Use report pointers</button>}

      <textarea aria-label="My presenter notes for this page" value={mine} onChange={e => typeMine(e.target.value)} placeholder="Your own points for this page. Saved with the report." style={{ fontSize: `${13 * fontScale}px` }}/>

    </div>}
    {next && <footer className="deck-drawer-next"><span>Up next</span><b>{tabs.find(t => t.id === next.tab)?.label} · {SECTION_LABEL[next.section]}</b></footer>}
  </aside>;
}

/** Notes-only window for a second screen, following the presenting tab. */
export function PoppedNotes({ model }: { model: ReportModel }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<{ tab: string; section: DeckSection; notes: SpeakerNotes; elapsed: number } | null>(null);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1.2);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!model.id || typeof BroadcastChannel === "undefined") return;
    const channel = new BroadcastChannel(`atlas-deck:${model.id}`);
    channel.onmessage = e => { if (e.data?.type === "page") setState(e.data); };
    channel.postMessage({ type: "request-page" });
    return () => channel.close();
  }, [model.id]);
  return <div className="deck-popped">
    <header><Mic size={16}/><b>{model.scope.studio} · speaker notes</b>{state && <span>{clock(state.elapsed)}</span>}
      <button className="icon-button" aria-label="Smaller text" onClick={() => setScale(s => Math.max(.8, s - .1))}><AArrowDown size={15}/></button>
      <button className="icon-button" aria-label="Larger text" onClick={() => setScale(s => Math.min(2.2, s + .1))}><AArrowUp size={15}/></button></header>
    {state ? <><h2>{SECTION_LABEL[state.section]}</h2><SpeakerNotesView notes={state.notes} fontScale={scale} teleprompter={false} /></> : <p className="deck-loading">Waiting for the presenting window… navigate a page there to sync.</p>}
  </div>;
}
